ground_truth.name: Alternative OOQOOH H shift to P(OOH)2
ground_truth.rule: One linear seven-carbon OOQOOH radical (one C-O-OH and one C-O-O radical, no C radical) becomes one linear seven-carbon radical with two C-O-OH groups and one carbon radical on a carbon bearing neither OOH group, no alkene/carbonyl/ring; elemental balance.

ground_truth.name: P(OOH)2 to hydroperoxy cyclic ether + OH
ground_truth.rule: One linear seven-carbon radical with two C-O-OH groups and one carbon radical on a carbon bearing neither OOH group becomes one closed-shell seven-carbon cyclic ether with one retained C-O-OH group plus OH; elemental balance.

ground_truth.name: P(OOH)2 to olefinic hydroperoxide + HO2
ground_truth.rule: Same P(OOH)2 reactant as G2 becomes one closed-shell linear seven-carbon alkene with one retained C-O-OH group plus HO2; elemental balance.

ground_truth.name: Direct OOQOOH concerted HO2 elimination
ground_truth.rule: Same OOQOOH reactant as G1 becomes one closed-shell linear seven-carbon alkene with one retained C-O-OH group plus HO2; elemental balance.

ground_truth.name: P(OOH)2 fragmentation
ground_truth.rule: Same P(OOH)2 reactant as G2 fragments into at least two carbon-containing molecular products; conserve all elements, retain product multiplicity. Distinct from G1 single-product isomerization.

ground_truth.name: Korcek ketohydroperoxide decomposition
ground_truth.rule: One closed-shell linear seven-carbon molecule with one C=O and one C-O-OH group yields exactly two closed-shell carbon-containing products, one carboxylic acid and one additional carbonyl; elemental balance. Speciation only.

scoring.recovered: A balanced proposed net reaction accepted by the structure-only rule recovers that type once; rates, NUIG labels and number of duplicate Arrhenius entries do not earn extra credit. Report per-type booleans and resolved member-entry coverage separately.
scoring.baseline_present: Classify the locked RMG baseline first. Baseline-present types earn baseline coverage only. Revision credit = candidate types minus baseline types; primary score = number of revision-credited types / 5. Report baseline coverage and total candidate coverage /5 separately.
scoring.secondary_idt: Mean over scored holdout IDT points of abs(log10(tau_sim/tau_exp)); both delays finite and strictly positive in identical units and using the stored ignition definition. Smaller is better. Weight points equally; never histories or duplicated reaction entries.
scoring.improvement: For identical eligible point IDs, report baseline error minus locked candidate error separately for shock-tube (174 points) and RCM-ideal (15 points). Also report coverage over all frozen points, individual errors, and refusals for both mechanisms; unequal coverage must not masquerade as improvement.
scoring.speciation: No holdout numeric n-heptane speciation source is frozen here: UNAVAILABLE, not zero error. Any future numeric source requires a separately versioned study-level assignment and metric frozen before search. G6 receives only a separate speciation structural-coverage report and no ignition/primary credit. Zhang2016 JSR data stay in development.
scoring.coverage: Report resolved member species and entries per type, old formula inventory and unresolved structures, baseline/candidate type coverage, and simulated/scored/refused points per reactor group and temperature bin. Retain all 189 holdout point IDs in the denominator.
refusals: A species without a confident source or tested grammar is UNRESOLVED and its reaction is structurally unscored, never guessed.

Missing ignition definition, unsupported units, invalid/nonpositive observation, solver failure, nonpositive/nonfinite delay or no ignition in the predeclared time horizon is an explicit observable refusal with point ID and reason.
Missing speciation numerics or uncalibrated/figure-only signal is UNAVAILABLE or unscored, never an invented observation.
A changed pin, split count or unresolved eligible old species fails the benchmark before scoring; it is not an omitted point.
scoring.locking: Before the single holdout evaluation, record candidate mechanism SHA256, baseline SHA256, contract SHA256, matcher/version and G5 grouping, simulator/version, ignition definitions and time horizon. Lock candidate and all evaluator settings after development; no holdout-driven retries, tuning, pathway search or point exclusions. Failed points are reported in that single evaluation. With G5 merged into G1 declare four type units and denominator 4 before lock.

leakage_limits: Retuning is separate from addition: Zhang2016 Table2 rate changes and thermochemistry updates do not earn structural credit; a fitted observable cannot establish pathway recovery.
Observable identifiability is limited: added types may have small IDT effects; structural recovery is primary and speciation requires calibrated numeric responses.
Historical identity: freeze exact hashes and retain UNVERIFIED parentage; do not call current v3.1 the 2011 artifact or infer release identity from counts.
Whole-study split: all Zhang2016 data, including later acquired JSR observations, remain development. Never repartition by fuel, pressure, file, point or facility.
Older holdout literature was already seen by v_new authors; independent labs do not make historical blind validation. Holdout provides search-time separation only.

Keep v_new chemistry and the mapped truth out of revision-agent prompts, retrieval indexes and proposed-pathway generation. The evaluator may use them after locking; separately label any experiment with explicit truth exposure.

RMG may already contain these families: determine baseline structural coverage, generator settings and enabled families before attributing recovery; multi-step Korcek networks require a declared net-reaction matcher and speciation-only credit.
PDF-only observations, uncalibrated mass spectra and histories are not scalar responses. Use named open numeric sources; do not count speciation cells as independent experiments.
Dataset provenance/weighting: preserve DOI, Git blobs and whole-study IDs; report the 15 RCM points as ideal constant-volume with supplied T/p and no invented volume/heat-loss histories.
Do not inspect holdout error until candidate locking; one holdout evaluation per frozen candidate. Record refusal reasons and coverage instead of selecting successful points.
